title: Aegis: Automated Error Generation and Attribution for Multi-Agent Systems
authors_zh: Fanqi Kong, Ruijie Zhang, Huaxiao Yin, Guibin Zhang, Xiaofei Zhang, Ziang Chen, Zhaowei Zhang, Xiaoyuan Zhang, Song-Chun Zhu, Xue Feng
paper_type_zh: 多智能体错误归因数据集、基准与 verifier/reward 方法
best_for_zh: 研究多智能体失败轨迹、SFT/GRPO 归因监督、mixed verifier、数据选择偏差与 episode 回放审计的读者
one_line: Aegis converts deterministic successful multi-agent runs into 9,533 evaluator-confirmed faulty trajectories with agent/error-mode labels, while mixed verifiers and selective failure retention bound reuse.
Aegis 将确定性成功的多智能体运行转化为 9,533 条经 mixed evaluator 确认失败的完整 episode，并附 agent/error-mode 归因；其选择性保留、分组策略未披露与未固定回放限制训练复用。
why: It makes the full MAS episode and injected agent/error map a concrete post-training object for SFT and GRPO, but also shows why synthetic intervention data must expose discarded attempts, grouped splits, verifier versions, baseline lineage, and immutable release manifests.
inclusion_reason: Aegis is a released, environment-linked corpus of evaluator-confirmed multi-agent failures whose episode-level agent/error labels support SFT, a structured GRPO reward, contrastive representation learning, and attribution evaluation; it directly exposes how intervention, terminal verification, and selective retention create agent-trajectory supervision.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Aegis is published as an ICLR 2026 conference paper; this Card uses the ICLR/OpenReview record, arXiv:2509.14295v6 (27 April 2026), the full paper and appendices, the author project and GitHub repository, and the official Hugging Face dataset as primary sources. The accepted metadata remains L3_summary_ready: the bilingual sources provide review-ready depth without upgrading the curation level or pre-populating a human Review decision.

The concrete problem is error attribution in a multi-agent system (MAS). A terminal task failure does not say which agent introduced the fault or which failure mode occurred, while naturally occurring failures rarely come with controlled ground truth. Aegis constructs such supervision by starting from a successful MAS trajectory, deliberately perturbing selected agents, retaining the resulting episode only if the task evaluator changes the outcome to failure, and using the injection plan as the attribution target (Paper §§4–5).

One released object is a failed full episode, not one injected error. The public JSONL viewer exposes top-level id, metadata, input, output, and ground_truth: visible records include the task/query, serialized conversation history, framework/benchmark/model/agent-count metadata, output.faulty_agents entries with agent name, error type, and injection strategy, plus the correct answer and injected-agent provenance. The corpus contains 9,533 faulty trajectories and 24,843 individual injected-error instances across 14 MAST-derived modes—about 2.6 injections per trajectory. Treating 24,843 as a trajectory count would misstate the data object.

This belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the supervision attaches to a complete interaction trace produced by one of six MAS frameworks—LLM Debate, MacNet, AgentVerse, DyLAN, SmolAgents, and Magentic-One—operating on MATH, GSM8K, HumanEval, SciBench, MMLU-Pro/MMLU, or GAIA. The environment/evaluator determines whether the intervention changes the terminal outcome, while the trace supplies the evidence from which a model predicts faulty agents and error modes.

The decision boundary is narrower than “replayable agent environment.” The verified release is primarily an offline JSONL corpus plus construction and evaluation code; exact GPT-4o-mini snapshots, evaluator versions, reset state, baseline-to-variant links, and a cross-artifact manifest are not pinned. Aegis supports the paper's SFT, GRPO/RLVR, contrastive, and evaluation studies, but it does not establish generic agent training, process supervision, preference learning, or immutable end-to-end replay.

Aegis 以 ICLR 2026 conference paper 发表；本卡片采用 ICLR/OpenReview 记录、2026 年 4 月 27 日的 arXiv:2509.14295v6、论文全文与附录、作者项目页和 GitHub 仓库，以及官方 Hugging Face dataset 作为一手来源。accepted metadata 仍为 L3_summary_ready：双语正文提供 review-ready 深度，但不提升 curation level，也不预填人工 Review 决策。

论文解决的具体问题是多智能体系统（MAS）中的错误归因。terminal task failure 本身不能说明由哪个 agent 引入错误、属于哪种 failure mode，而自然发生的失败通常没有受控 ground truth。Aegis 从成功 MAS trajectory 出发，故意扰动选定 agent；只有 task evaluator 将结果从成功改判为失败时才保留该 episode，并把 injection plan 作为 attribution target（论文第 4–5 节）。

一条发布对象是一段失败的完整 episode，而不是单个注入错误。公开 JSONL Viewer 暴露顶层 id、metadata、input、output 与 ground_truth；可见记录包含 task/query、序列化 conversation history、framework/benchmark/model/agent-count metadata，含 agent name、error type 与 injection strategy 的 output.faulty_agents，以及 correct answer 和 injected-agent provenance。语料包含 9,533 条 faulty trajectory 和 24,843 个独立 injected-error instance，覆盖 14 种由 MAST 派生的 mode，平均每条 trajectory 约 2.6 个注入。把 24,843 写成轨迹数量会误述数据对象。

它属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为监督附着在六种 MAS framework——LLM Debate、MacNet、AgentVerse、DyLAN、SmolAgents、Magentic-One——之一产生的完整交互 trace 上，任务来自 MATH、GSM8K、HumanEval、SciBench、MMLU-Pro/MMLU 或 GAIA。environment/evaluator 决定干预是否改变 terminal outcome，trace 则提供模型预测 faulty agent 与 error mode 所需的证据。

收录边界比“可回放 agent environment”更窄。已核验发布主要是 offline JSONL corpus 加构造与评测代码；确切 GPT-4o-mini snapshot、evaluator version、reset state、baseline-to-variant link 与跨 artifact manifest 均未固定。Aegis 支持论文中的 SFT、GRPO/RLVR、contrastive 与 evaluation 研究，但不能据此扩张为通用 agent training、process supervision、preference learning 或不可变的端到端 replay。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution in one sentence is: Aegis turns deterministic successful MAS runs into evaluator-confirmed failed episodes whose planned agent/error interventions become episode-level attribution labels, then exposes those labels through SFT, structured GRPO reward, contrastive learning, and benchmark evaluation.

The mechanism separates intervention from verification. An adaptive LLM manipulator reads the task and agent roles, chooses prompt injection or response corruption, and creates a unique plan of target-agent/error-mode pairs drawn from 14 MAST-derived modes in three families: specification issues, inter-agent misalignment, and task-verification failures. The perturbed MAS executes normally; the planned labels enter the corpus only when a task-specific evaluator observes that the previously successful task now fails. DyLAN receives an additional post-hoc label-refinement step whose procedure is not disclosed in enough detail for independent audit.

The feedback contract is mixed. Math uses normalized numeric/LaTeX comparison, HumanEval executes tests with a timeout, SciBench applies unit-aware numeric tolerances, and MMLU-Pro extracts choices A–J. GAIA first extracts an answer and then uses GPT-4o-mini for semantic judgment. These checks observe terminal answer behavior under benchmark-specific rules; they do not directly verify every intermediate turn, prove that each injected error was necessary, or rule out evaluator false positives and false negatives.

For GRPO, feedback shifts from construction-time terminal failure to an output-level scalar reward. Predicted and gold JSON are parsed into agent/error pairs: exact pairs receive full credit; a correct agent or correct error can receive non-repeatable partial credit; malformed JSON, duplicates, false positives, and excess outputs are penalized; the score is normalized before optimization (Paper §5.2; Appendix C.2). This reward checks structured attribution, not whether the model reconstructs the causal chain turn by turn.

The nearest evaluation contrast inside the paper is Who&When, used as an out-of-distribution attribution benchmark. Aegis-Bench is sampled from the same six source task families as training and validation, whereas Who&When tests transfer to naturally presented failures. The key difference is that Aegis labels are generated by controlled intervention and retained terminal failure; this yields scalable labels but does not establish counterfactual causal ground truth for emergent or multi-cause failures.

一句话贡献是：Aegis 把确定性成功的 MAS 运行转化为经 evaluator 确认失败的 episode，将预先规划的 agent/error 干预作为 episode-level attribution label，并把这些标签用于 SFT、结构化 GRPO reward、contrastive learning 与 benchmark evaluation。

核心机制把 intervention 与 verification 分开。adaptive LLM manipulator 读取 task 与 agent role，选择 prompt injection 或 response corruption，并从 14 种 MAST 派生 mode 中创建唯一的 target-agent/error-mode pair 计划；这些 mode 分为 specification issue、inter-agent misalignment 与 task-verification failure 三类。受扰动 MAS 继续正常执行；只有 task-specific evaluator 观察到原本成功的任务变成失败时，计划标签才进入语料。DyLAN 还接受 post-hoc label refinement，但其流程披露不足，无法独立审计。

反馈契约是 mixed。Math 使用归一化 numeric/LaTeX comparison；HumanEval 在 timeout 下执行 test；SciBench 使用考虑单位的 numeric tolerance；MMLU-Pro 抽取 A–J 选项；GAIA 则先抽取 answer，再由 GPT-4o-mini 进行 semantic judgment。这些检查按照 benchmark-specific rule 观察 terminal answer behavior；它们不会直接验证每个 intermediate turn，也不能证明每个 injected error 都是必要原因，更不能排除 evaluator 的 false positive 与 false negative。

在 GRPO 中，反馈从构造阶段的 terminal failure 转为 output-level scalar reward。prediction 与 gold JSON 被解析为 agent/error pair：完全匹配得到 full credit；agent 或 error 单侧正确可获得不可重复的 partial credit；malformed JSON、duplicate、false positive 与 excess output 会被惩罚；最终分数在优化前归一化（论文第 5.2 节、Appendix C.2）。该 reward 检查结构化归因，不检查模型是否逐 turn 重建因果链。

论文内部最接近的评测对照是作为 out-of-distribution attribution benchmark 的 Who&When。Aegis-Bench 与 train/validation 来自相同六类 source task，而 Who&When 测试对自然呈现失败的迁移。关键差异是：Aegis 标签由受控 intervention 与被保留的 terminal failure 生成；这种设计能扩展标签规模，但不能为 emergent 或 multi-cause failure 提供反事实 causal ground truth。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and successful baselines. Tasks come from MATH, GSM8K, HumanEval, SciBench, MMLU-Pro/MMLU, and GAIA and are executed through LLM Debate, MacNet, AgentVerse, DyLAN, SmolAgents, or Magentic-One. All MAS agents are standardized to GPT-4o-mini at temperature 0 with a fixed random seed. For each source task, the pipeline first retains a trajectory whose task evaluator reports success. The exact GPT-4o-mini snapshot, upstream task versions, baseline count, and stable record-level baseline IDs are unknown (Paper §§4.1–4.3).

Intervention and rollout. A context-aware manipulator, run at temperature 0.7, builds unique target-agent/error-mode plans and randomly applies either prompt injection or response corruption. The perturbed system is rolled out under its framework. Exact manipulator model identity, plans or attempts per baseline, retry budget, total attempted injections, and construction API/token budget are not disclosed. DyLAN labels receive post-hoc refinement, but the rule and adjudication log are not released.

Terminal verification and filtering. Each benchmark has its own terminal evaluator: normalized comparison for mathematics, executable tests for HumanEval, unit/tolerance-aware checks for SciBench, A–J extraction for MMLU-Pro, and GPT-4o-mini semantic judgment for GAIA. The pipeline retains only interventions that change a successful baseline into evaluator-confirmed failure, Z(τ_injected)=1; non-failing injections and self-corrected episodes are absent from the inspected release. The ground-truth attribution map is the injection plan itself, so labeling is by construction rather than independent causal adjudication.

Released object and split. A retained row contains the full failed conversation/execution history, task and framework metadata, faulty-agent/error-mode labels, injection strategy, correct answer, and injected-agent provenance. The resulting corpus has 9,533 trajectories with 24,843 injection instances. The paper selects 100 trajectories from each of six benchmarks for Aegis-Bench (600); the remainder is split 80/20 with a fixed seed. The HF surface is approximately 7,147 train / 1,786 validation / 600 test. The paper states trajectory-level non-overlap but does not disclose grouping by upstream task or successful baseline, deduplication, or decontamination.

Training and evaluation interfaces. SFT serializes the trajectory and taxonomy definitions as prompt x and targets JSON o containing faulty agents and modes. GRPO uses the structured partial-credit/penalty reward described in §5.2. DCL treats an episode as a bag of turns, learns evidence-turn attention and agent/error prototypes, and combines BCE, supervised contrastive, and hierarchy-consistency losses; successful baselines are described as positive anchors, but their presence in the public JSONL was not verified. Evaluation reports exact pair, agent, error, Micro-F1, and Macro-F1 metrics on Aegis-Bench and Who&When.

Implementation and replay boundary. SFT/GRPO use verl, four A800 GPUs, batch size 64, three epochs, maximum sequence length 8,192, and reported learning rates 3e-6/5e-6; GRPO reports LoRA rank 64 and KL coefficient 0.001. Reproduction must pin arXiv v6, GitHub commit ced13443…, HF revisions and hashes, model/API snapshots, evaluator code and GAIA judge prompt, dependencies, seeds, baseline lineage, and reset state. No common release manifest binds those objects, so the code/data release is useful for offline study but does not establish immutable end-to-end replay.

输入与成功 baseline。 任务来自 MATH、GSM8K、HumanEval、SciBench、MMLU-Pro/MMLU 与 GAIA，并通过 LLM Debate、MacNet、AgentVerse、DyLAN、SmolAgents 或 Magentic-One 执行。全部 MAS agent 统一使用 temperature 0 的 GPT-4o-mini 与固定 random seed。对每个 source task，pipeline 先保留 task evaluator 判为成功的 trajectory。确切 GPT-4o-mini snapshot、上游 task version、baseline 数量与稳定的 record-level baseline ID 均为 unknown（论文第 4.1–4.3 节）。

干预与 rollout。 context-aware manipulator 在 temperature 0.7 下构造唯一的 target-agent/error-mode 计划，并随机采用 prompt injection 或 response corruption。受扰动系统继续在其 framework 中 rollout。确切 manipulator model 身份、每个 baseline 的 plan/attempt 数、retry budget、注入尝试总量与构造 API/token budget 均未披露。DyLAN label 接受 post-hoc refinement，但规则与 adjudication log 未发布。

Terminal verification 与过滤。 各 benchmark 使用不同 terminal evaluator：数学任务做 normalized comparison；HumanEval 执行 test；SciBench 采用 unit/tolerance-aware check；MMLU-Pro 抽取 A–J；GAIA 使用 GPT-4o-mini semantic judgment。pipeline 仅保留把成功 baseline 变成 evaluator-confirmed failure 的干预，即 Z(τ_injected)=1；在已检查的发布中看不到 non-failing injection 与 self-corrected episode。ground-truth attribution map 直接等于 injection plan，因此标签来自构造，而非独立 causal adjudication。

发布对象与划分。 一条保留 row 包含完整失败 conversation/execution history、task/framework metadata、faulty-agent/error-mode label、injection strategy、correct answer 与 injected-agent provenance。最终语料共有 9,533 条 trajectory、24,843 个 injection instance。论文从六个 benchmark 各选 100 条组成 Aegis-Bench（共 600 条），其余按固定 seed 以 80/20 划分。HF surface 约为 7,147 train / 1,786 validation / 600 test。论文声明 trajectory-level 不重叠，但没有披露是否按 upstream task 或 successful baseline 分组，也没有给出 deduplication 或 decontamination 程序。

训练与评测接口。 SFT 将 trajectory 与 taxonomy definition 序列化为 prompt x，目标 o 是包含 faulty agent 与 mode 的 JSON。GRPO 使用第 5.2 节所述结构化 partial-credit/penalty reward。DCL 把 episode 视为 turn bag，学习 evidence-turn attention 与 agent/error prototype，并组合 BCE、supervised contrastive 与 hierarchy-consistency loss；论文把 successful baseline 描述为 positive anchor，但未核验其是否出现在公开 JSONL。评测在 Aegis-Bench 与 Who&When 上报告 exact pair、agent、error、Micro-F1 和 Macro-F1。

实现与 replay 边界。 SFT/GRPO 使用 verl、4 张 A800 GPU、batch size 64、3 个 epoch、最大 sequence length 8,192，报告的 learning rate 分别为 3e-6/5e-6；GRPO 还报告 LoRA rank 64 与 KL coefficient 0.001。复现必须固定 arXiv v6、GitHub commit ced13443…、HF revision 与 hash、model/API snapshot、evaluator code 与 GAIA judge prompt、dependency、seed、baseline lineage 和 reset state。当前没有统一 release manifest 绑定这些对象，因此 code/data release 适合 offline study，但不能证明端到端 immutable replay。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Scale evidence must preserve two denominators. Paper §4.3 and Appendix Table 2 report 9,533 faulty trajectories containing 24,843 injected agent/error instances, not 24,843 trajectories. By task, the trajectory counts are MATH 2,048, SciBench 1,871, GSM8K 1,741, HumanEval 1,497, MMLU 1,446, and GAIA 954. By framework they are LLM Debate 2,404, MacNet 2,359, AgentVerse 1,995, DyLAN 1,845, SmolAgents 481, and Magentic-One 449. The arithmetic in both partitions sums to 9,533.

Table 1 reports attribution results under the paper's training setup. Aegis-SFT with Qwen2.5-14B averages 26.51 across the Aegis-Bench and Who&When metrics shown, compared with 13.99 for the corresponding base model; Aegis-GRPO reports 18.41. The DCL method reports 12.61 versus a 4.08 random baseline. These are author-reported aggregate scores under disclosed model/training combinations and were not independently reproduced for this Card.

The human check tests label fidelity on only a sample. Three experts independently label 100 Aegis-Bench trajectories; Appendix B.3 reports human-human Fleiss' κ=0.85 and program-human κ=0.81. This is evidence that planned attribution often agrees with expert reading on that sample. Recruitment, raw judgments, per-mode errors, disagreement adjudication, and whether the sample represents all frameworks and rare modes are not released, so the result does not validate every row or establish causal necessity.

The paper also reports negative evidence. In the SFT epoch study, out-of-distribution Who&When performance peaks after two epochs and then declines while in-domain Aegis-Bench continues to improve; the authors attribute this divergence to overfitting synthetic style (Paper §7, Figure 3c). Appendix A.2 shows a geography case in which every tested model, including Aegis, misses a subtle numeric root cause. Macro-F1 also trails Micro-F1 for rarer error modes. These results limit claims of transfer and taxonomy coverage.

Artifact evidence is stronger for availability than for replay. The official HF repository exposes train, validation, and test JSONL files with audited SHA-256 hashes add3aae4…6466a8, fe0b3d0e…f1ffe49, and a2f2793f…9f65bd1; the GitHub repository exposes construction/evaluation code at audited commit ced13443…. However, no common version binds paper, code, data, model APIs, and evaluators. Benchmark gains therefore demonstrate performance in the reported setup; they do not prove data quality, split isolation, verifier correctness, legal reuse, release completeness, or deterministic replay.

规模证据必须保留两个不同分母。论文第 4.3 节与 Appendix Table 2 报告 9,533 条 faulty trajectory，其中包含 24,843 个 injected agent/error instance，而不是 24,843 条轨迹。按 task 划分：MATH 2,048、SciBench 1,871、GSM8K 1,741、HumanEval 1,497、MMLU 1,446、GAIA 954；按 framework 划分：LLM Debate 2,404、MacNet 2,359、AgentVerse 1,995、DyLAN 1,845、SmolAgents 481、Magentic-One 449。两种划分的算术合计都为 9,533。

Table 1 报告论文训练设置下的归因结果。使用 Qwen2.5-14B 的 Aegis-SFT 在所列 Aegis-Bench 与 Who&When metric 上平均为 26.51，对应 base model 为 13.99；Aegis-GRPO 报告 18.41；DCL 报告 12.61，random baseline 为 4.08。这些是指定 model/training combination 下的作者报告 aggregate score，本卡片未做独立复现。

human check 只在一个样本上检验 label fidelity。三位专家独立标注 100 条 Aegis-Bench trajectory；Appendix B.3 报告 human-human Fleiss' κ=0.85、program-human κ=0.81。这说明 planned attribution 在该样本上通常与专家阅读一致。由于 recruitment、raw judgment、逐 mode error、disagreement adjudication，以及样本是否覆盖全部 framework 与 rare mode 均未发布，该结果不能验证每一条 row，也不能证明因果必要性。

论文还报告了负面证据。SFT epoch 研究中，out-of-distribution Who&When 性能在第二个 epoch 后达到峰值并下降，而 in-domain Aegis-Bench 继续提高；作者将这种分化归因于对 synthetic style 的过拟合（论文第 7 节、Figure 3c）。Appendix A.2 的 geography case 显示所有测试模型（包括 Aegis）都遗漏了细微 numeric root cause。rare error mode 上的 Macro-F1 也落后于 Micro-F1。这些结果限制对 transfer 与 taxonomy coverage 的主张。

artifact 证据对“可获得”比对“可回放”更强。官方 HF repository 暴露 train、validation 与 test JSONL，审计到的 SHA-256 分别为 add3aae4…6466a8、fe0b3d0e…f1ffe49、a2f2793f…9f65bd1；GitHub repository 在审计 commit ced13443… 暴露构造与评测代码。但没有统一版本绑定 paper、code、data、model API 与 evaluator。因此 benchmark gain 只证明论文所述设置中的表现，不能证明 data quality、split isolation、verifier correctness、合法复用、release completeness 或 deterministic replay。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior multi-agent diagnosis can evaluate terminal success or ask a model to identify a faulty participant, and Aegis inherits its 14-mode taxonomy from MAST. Prompt injection, response corruption, SFT, GRPO, contrastive objectives, and the six source benchmarks or MAS frameworks are not individually new. The relevant baseline is therefore sparse or naturally observed attribution data, not the absence of any earlier multi-agent evaluation.

Aegis changes the data object by pairing a complete failed MAS episode with a controlled intervention record: selected agents, error modes, injection strategy, correct answer, and planned provenance. It changes selection by requiring a paired successful baseline and retaining only perturbations that reverse the task evaluator's outcome. This connects a trace, a terminal predicate, and an attribution target in one post-training object rather than treating failure as an unlabeled transcript.

The feedback interface has two layers. Construction uses heterogeneous task evaluators to decide whether an intervention enters the corpus; GRPO converts structured agent/error agreement into a normalized scalar reward with partial credit and penalties for malformed, duplicate, false-positive, or excessive outputs. DCL adds turn attention and agent/error prototypes to reuse the same episode-level labels. The important direction signal is this alignment of intervention, retention, structured target, and downstream reward—not any one optimizer.

The main engineering contribution is breadth: 9,533 failures, 24,843 injections, six task families, six MAS frameworks, and 14 modes. Scale does not resolve the epistemic boundary. Because the label equals the planned intervention, the release knows what was changed, but it does not prove which change was necessary when several agents are perturbed or capture unexpected emergent failures outside the taxonomy.

Before reuse, researchers should verify the complete nested JSONL schema, whether successful baselines used as DCL anchors are public, the discarded-attempt ledger, grouped split isolation, DyLAN refinement, exact evaluator and GAIA judge versions, model snapshots, upstream rights, and a manifest binding paper/code/HF revisions and hashes. Those checks determine whether the novelty is usable as training data, an attribution benchmark, or only a construction/audit reference.

既有多智能体诊断已经可以评测 terminal success，或要求模型识别 faulty participant；Aegis 的 14-mode taxonomy 也继承自 MAST。prompt injection、response corruption、SFT、GRPO、contrastive objective，以及六类 source benchmark 或 MAS framework 都不是单独的新机制。因此应比较的 prior baseline 是稀疏或自然观察到的 attribution data，而不是假设过去不存在多智能体评测。

Aegis 改变了数据对象：它把完整失败 MAS episode 与受控 intervention record 绑定，后者包含 selected agent、error mode、injection strategy、correct answer 与 planned provenance。它也改变了选择过程：每条数据先要求一个配对的 successful baseline，只有让 task evaluator 结果反转的 perturbation 才被保留。这样，trace、terminal predicate 与 attribution target 被连接在同一 post-training object 中，而不是把失败当作没有标签的 transcript。

feedback interface 分为两层。构造阶段用异构 task evaluator 决定一个 intervention 是否进入语料；GRPO 则把结构化 agent/error 一致性转成 normalized scalar reward，并对 malformed、duplicate、false-positive 或 excess output 给出 partial credit 或 penalty。DCL 进一步加入 turn attention 与 agent/error prototype，以复用相同 episode-level label。真正的方向信号是 intervention、retention、structured target 与 downstream reward 的对齐，而非某个单独 optimizer。

主要工程贡献是覆盖广度：9,533 条 failure、24,843 个 injection、六类 task、六种 MAS framework 与 14 种 mode。规模不能消除认识边界。由于 label 等于 planned intervention，发布能说明“改了什么”，却不能在同时扰动多个 agent 时证明“哪项改动是必要原因”，也不能覆盖 taxonomy 之外未预期的 emergent failure。

复用前应核验完整 nested JSONL schema、DCL 作为 anchor 的 successful baseline 是否公开、discarded-attempt ledger、grouped split isolation、DyLAN refinement、确切 evaluator 与 GAIA judge version、model snapshot、上游 rights，以及绑定 paper/code/HF revision 与 hash 的 manifest。这些检查决定该新意可用于 training data、attribution benchmark，还是只能作为 construction/audit reference。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Attribution by construction: Gold labels equal the planned target-agent/error-mode injections. When several agents are perturbed, terminal failure shows that the combined intervention defeated the evaluator, not that every label was independently necessary or causal. Controlled MAST modes also underrepresent emergent, interaction-induced, or unseen failures; the paper states the fixed taxonomy and controlled plans as limitations.
  • Failure-only selection: Only interventions that turn a successful baseline into evaluator-confirmed failure enter the 9,533-row corpus. Counts and records for non-failing injections, self-corrections, retries, and rejected attempts are unknown. This removes resilience evidence and can make intervention artifacts or evaluator weaknesses predictive of the label.
  • Mixed-verifier risk: Math normalization, code tests, scientific tolerances, multiple-choice extraction, and the GPT-4o-mini GAIA judge have different false-positive and false-negative modes. The exact evaluator versions and GAIA judge prompt/model snapshot are unpinned; a format or judge error can determine both retention and the apparent ground truth.
  • Split and contamination risk: The approximate 7,147/1,786/600 train/validation/test split is non-overlapping only at the reported trajectory level. No grouping by upstream task or successful baseline, deduplication, or decontamination method is disclosed. Multiple injected variants of shared source content may therefore cross splits, while all in-domain splits reuse the same six benchmark families.
  • Incomplete lineage and replay: Public rows do not verify stable baseline-to-variant links, exact GPT-4o-mini/manipulator snapshots, attempts per baseline, reset state, dependency lock, or record-specific evaluator version. Mutable GitHub and HF histories lack one release manifest, so identical end-to-end construction cannot be assumed from the available code.
  • Release and license boundary: HF data and GitHub code declare MIT, while arXiv v6 is CC BY 4.0; rights for upstream benchmark items, framework outputs, and model-generated traces are not reconciled. The paper says models are open-sourced, but no official model artifact link was verified. Dataset/code availability does not settle model availability or upstream redistribution rights.
  • Label-audit gaps: DyLAN post-hoc refinement lacks a reconstructable procedure. The three-expert 100-trajectory study reports κ values but not recruitment, raw labels, per-mode errors, disagreement adjudication, compensation, or consent, limiting audit of rare labels and human comparison.
  • Generalization and experiment drift: SFT overfits synthetic style on Who&When after two epochs, and all tested models miss the Appendix A.2 numeric root cause. The main text and Appendix D disagree on whether DCL used four RTX 4090 or four RTX 3090 GPUs. Reported benchmark improvements therefore do not prove broad failure coverage, data quality, or exact reproducibility.

• 构造式归因： gold label 直接等于 planned target-agent/error-mode injection。同时扰动多个 agent 时，terminal failure 只能说明组合干预击败了 evaluator，不能证明每个标签都是独立必要原因。受控 MAST mode 还会低估 emergent、interaction-induced 或 unseen failure；论文也把固定 taxonomy 与受控 plan 明确列为限制。
  • 只保留失败的选择： 只有把 successful baseline 变成 evaluator-confirmed failure 的 intervention 才进入 9,533-row corpus。non-failing injection、self-correction、retry 与 rejected attempt 的数量和记录均为 unknown。这会移除 resilience 证据，并可能让 intervention artifact 或 evaluator weakness 成为标签捷径。
  • Mixed-verifier 风险： 数学归一化、code test、科学数值 tolerance、multiple-choice extraction 与 GPT-4o-mini GAIA judge 各有不同 false-positive/false-negative mode。确切 evaluator version 与 GAIA judge prompt/model snapshot 未固定；format 或 judge 错误可能同时决定样本是否保留以及表观 ground truth。
  • 划分与污染风险： 约 7,147/1,786/600 的 train/validation/test 只在论文所述 trajectory level 不重叠。未披露按 upstream task 或 successful baseline 分组、deduplication 或 decontamination 方法。因此，共享 source content 的多个 injected variant 可能跨 split，而所有 in-domain split 都复用相同六类 benchmark。
  • Lineage 与 replay 不完整： 公开 row 不能验证稳定的 baseline-to-variant link、确切 GPT-4o-mini/manipulator snapshot、每个 baseline 的 attempt 数、reset state、dependency lock 或逐记录 evaluator version。可变 GitHub/HF history 缺少统一 release manifest，不能因代码公开就假设端到端构造可相同重放。
  • 发布与 license 边界： HF data 与 GitHub code 声明 MIT，arXiv v6 为 CC BY 4.0；上游 benchmark item、framework output 与 model-generated trace 的权利未调和。论文称 model 已开源，但未核验到官方 model artifact 链接。data/code 可得不等于 model 可得，也不能解决上游 redistribution right。
  • 标签审计缺口： DyLAN post-hoc refinement 缺少可重建流程。三位专家、100 条 trajectory 的研究报告 κ 值，但没有 recruitment、raw label、逐 mode error、disagreement adjudication、compensation 或 consent，限制了 rare label 与 human comparison 的审计。
  • 泛化与实验漂移： SFT 在两个 epoch 后对 Who&When 出现 synthetic-style overfitting，所有测试模型也都遗漏 Appendix A.2 的 numeric root cause。正文与 Appendix D 对 DCL 使用 4 张 RTX 4090 还是 4 张 RTX 3090 存在冲突。因此报告的 benchmark improvement 不能证明广泛 failure coverage、data quality 或准确可复现性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, Aegis is most useful as an offline full-episode corpus for studying multi-agent failure attribution. A researcher can preserve the query, ordered interaction history, framework and agent metadata, planned intervention, evaluator outcome, agent/error labels, and correct-answer provenance, then separate errors in generation, communication, verification, and attribution. The card also supplies an audit template for asking whether an “agent trajectory” is paired with its baseline, terminal predicate, discarded attempts, and replay metadata.

The released supervision supports a bounded SFT recipe: serialize the complete episode plus the 14-mode taxonomy and predict structured JSON identifying faulty agents and error modes. It also supports the paper's structured GRPO/RLVR reward, including exact-pair credit, one-time partial credit, and format/duplicate/false-positive/excess penalties. These uses should retain the source split and version metadata and should report Micro-F1 and Macro-F1 separately, because rare modes are obscured by aggregate frequency.

The construction pipeline is reusable as an experimental recipe: obtain evaluator-confirmed successful baselines, design explicit agent/error interventions, apply prompt or response corruption, rerun the MAS, retain only outcome reversals, and preserve both the plan and full failed trace. A stronger follow-up should additionally release all attempts, including non-failing and self-corrected runs, and group splits by upstream task and baseline. This would permit resilience analysis and cleaner counterfactual comparisons rather than learning only from interventions that defeat the evaluator.

The mixed verifier is a concrete research surface. Teams can compare normalized answer checks, executable tests, tolerance rules, extractors, and the GAIA LLM judge; measure false positives and false negatives; vary evaluator versions; and test whether GRPO learns formatting or attribution shortcuts. The 100-trajectory expert study can be extended with released raw labels, stratification by mode/framework, blinded adjudication, and causal-ablation checks that remove one injected error at a time.

Reuse class: conditional research training and evaluation, not a replayable agent environment. Pin the audited code/HF revisions and hashes, verify local license and upstream-rights requirements, keep Aegis-Bench isolated, and disclose that only induced failures were released. Do not broaden the evidence to generic agent training, dense process supervision, preference learning, or model-checkpoint reuse; exact model artifacts, complete baseline lineage, grouped splits, evaluator snapshots, and immutable replay remain unresolved.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，Aegis 最适合作为研究多智能体失败归因的 offline full-episode corpus。研究者可以保留 query、ordered interaction history、framework/agent metadata、planned intervention、evaluator outcome、agent/error label 与 correct-answer provenance，再区分 generation、communication、verification 和 attribution 中的错误。该卡片也提供一套审计模板，用于检查“agent trajectory”是否带有配对 baseline、terminal predicate、discarded attempt 与 replay metadata。

发布的监督支持边界明确的 SFT recipe：序列化完整 episode 与 14-mode taxonomy，预测包含 faulty agent 和 error mode 的结构化 JSON。它也支持论文中的 structured GRPO/RLVR reward，包括 exact-pair credit、一次性 partial credit，以及对 format、duplicate、false-positive、excess output 的 penalty。这些用途应保留 source split 与 version metadata，并分别报告 Micro-F1 与 Macro-F1，因为 aggregate frequency 会掩盖 rare mode。

构造 pipeline 可以复用为实验 recipe：获取 evaluator-confirmed successful baseline，设计明确 agent/error intervention，实施 prompt 或 response corruption，重新运行 MAS，只保留 outcome reversal，并同时保存 plan 与完整 failed trace。更强的后续发布还应包含所有 attempt，包括 non-failing 与 self-corrected run，并按 upstream task 和 baseline 分组划分。这样才能分析 resilience，形成更干净的 counterfactual comparison，而不只是学习“恰好击败 evaluator”的干预。

mixed verifier 是具体研究面。团队可以比较 normalized answer check、executable test、tolerance rule、extractor 与 GAIA LLM judge；测量 false positive/false negative；改变 evaluator version；并测试 GRPO 是否学习 format 或 attribution shortcut。100-trajectory expert study 可扩展为发布 raw label、按 mode/framework 分层、blind adjudication，以及逐个移除 injected error 的 causal-ablation check。

复用等级：有条件的研究训练与评测，而不是可回放 agent environment。应固定已审计 code/HF revision 与 hash，核验本地 license 和上游 rights 要求，隔离 Aegis-Bench，并披露发布只包含 induced failure。不得把证据扩张到通用 agent training、dense process supervision、preference learning 或 model-checkpoint reuse；确切 model artifact、完整 baseline lineage、grouped split、evaluator snapshot 与 immutable replay 仍未解决。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Paper §§4.1–4.3 and Appendix Table 2: one row is a failed full MAS episode with attribution labels; the release has 9,533 trajectories and 24,843 injected-error instances, so those counts must never be interchanged.
  • Read the “Validation and Ground Truth Labeling” step together with Appendix B.1: retention depends on benchmark-specific evaluators, including a GPT-4o-mini semantic judge for GAIA, while the injected plan—not an independent causal annotation—supplies the agent/error target.
  • Use Paper §§5.1–5.3 and Appendix C to separate three interfaces: JSON-target SFT, normalized structured GRPO reward, and DCL over bags of turns. Only SFT, RLVR, contrastive learning, and evaluation are evidenced; successful DCL anchors are not verified in the public JSONL.
  • Treat Table 1 and Appendix B.3 as author-reported performance and sample-level label-fidelity evidence. Figure 3c and Appendix A.2 are equally important: they show synthetic-style overfitting and a subtle root cause missed by every tested model.
  • Before reuse, resolve grouped splitting, discarded/non-failing attempts, complete nested schema, DyLAN refinement, evaluator/GAIA judge snapshots, upstream rights, official model artifacts, and a manifest binding arXiv v6, GitHub commit, HF revisions/hashes, dependencies, and seeds.

• 先读论文第 4.1–4.3 节与 Appendix Table 2：一条 row 是带归因标签的失败完整 MAS episode；发布包含 9,533 条 trajectory 与 24,843 个 injected-error instance，这两个数量绝不能互换。
  • 将“Validation and Ground Truth Labeling”与 Appendix B.1 对读：样本保留依赖 benchmark-specific evaluator，其中 GAIA 使用 GPT-4o-mini semantic judge；agent/error target 来自 injected plan，而不是独立 causal annotation。
  • 用论文第 5.1–5.3 节与 Appendix C 区分三类接口：JSON-target SFT、normalized structured GRPO reward，以及对 turn bag 的 DCL。证据仅支持 SFT、RLVR、contrastive learning 与 evaluation；公开 JSONL 中是否包含 successful DCL anchor 尚未核验。
  • Table 1 与 Appendix B.3 应视为作者报告性能与样本级 label-fidelity 证据。Figure 3c 和 Appendix A.2 同样重要：它们分别显示 synthetic-style overfitting，以及所有测试模型都遗漏的细微 root cause。
  • 复用前应解决 grouped split、discarded/non-failing attempt、完整 nested schema、DyLAN refinement、evaluator/GAIA judge snapshot、上游 rights、官方 model artifact，以及绑定 arXiv v6、GitHub commit、HF revision/hash、dependency 与 seed 的 manifest。

value.html: Construction keeps an injected rollout only when a task-specific evaluator marks the final outcome failed. Math uses normalized answer matching, HumanEval executes tests, SciBench uses tolerance-aware numeric comparison, MMLU-Pro uses choice extraction, and GAIA uses GPT-4o-mini semantic judgment. DCL uses all-MiniLM-L6-V2 with MIL attention and classification/contrastive/hierarchy losses for two epochs; the main text says 4 RTX 4090 GPUs while Appendix D.1 says 4 RTX 3090 GPUs.

value_zh.html: SFT 和 GRPO 使用 verl 于 4 块 A800 GPU。Table 6 报告 batch size 64、三个 epoch、学习率 3e-6（SFT）和 5e-6（GRPO），以及 GRPO LoRA rank 64、KL 系数 0.001。DCL 使用 all-MiniLM-L6-V2，配合 MIL attention 以及分类/对比/层次损失，共两个 epoch；正文称 4 块 RTX 4090 GPU，而 Appendix D.1 称 4 块 RTX 3090 GPU。

value.html: 9,533 induced-failure trajectories from six upstream task families and six MAS frameworks; 24,843 agent/error injections across 14 MAST-derived modes. The corpus deliberately excludes injections that do not induce task failure.

value_zh.html: 来自六个上游任务族与六个 MAS 框架的 9,533 条诱发失败轨迹；24,843 次智能体/错误注入，跨越 14 个 MAST 派生模式。该语料有意排除未诱发任务失败的注入。

value.html: Paper §6 selects 100 trajectories per benchmark for Aegis-Bench (600 total), then splits the remainder 80/20 into train/validation with a fixed seed. HF shows approximately 7.15k train, 1.79k validation, and 600 test rows. No group-by-upstream-task or group-by-successful-baseline policy is disclosed.

value_zh.html: 论文 §6 为 Aegis-Bench 每个基准选取 100 条轨迹（共 600 条），然后将剩余部分以固定种子按 80/20 划分为 train/validation。HF 显示约 7.15k train、1.79k validation 和 600 test 行。未披露按上游任务分组或按成功基线分组的策略。

value.html: Training, validation, and test all originate from the same six benchmark families. The paper states trajectory subsets are non-overlapping, but does not show that injected variants sharing an upstream task or successful baseline cannot cross splits; Who&When is used only as an external OOD evaluation set.

value_zh.html: 训练、验证和测试均源自相同的六个基准族。论文称轨迹子集不重叠，但未表明共享上游任务或成功基线的注入变体不能跨划分；Who&When 仅用作外部 OOD 评测集。

value.html: Only evaluator-confirmed induced failures are retained as the 9,533-row corpus. Successful baselines are described as contrastive anchors, but their serialization in the public JSONL release is not verified. Counts and records for non-failing injections, self-corrections, and other discarded attempts are unknown.

value_zh.html: 仅评测器确认的诱发失败被保留为 9,533 行语料。成功基线被描述为对比锚点，但其在公开 JSONL 发布中的序列化未经核验。未失败注入、自我纠正及其他被丢弃尝试的计数与记录未知。

items: The attribution target equals the planned injections; it does not establish that every injected error was necessary or independently causal when multiple agents are perturbed.
Controlled MAST-mode injections may not represent emergent, interaction-induced or previously unseen failures; the paper explicitly identifies the fixed taxonomy and controlled plans as limitations.
GAIA failure selection depends on GPT-4o-mini semantic judgment, while format normalizers, unit tolerances, code tests and extraction rules can also produce false positives or false negatives.
Multiple variants can originate from a common task or successful baseline, but grouped splitting is undisclosed, creating possible train/test structural leakage.
Discarding non-failing injections removes evidence of resilience and self-correction and can teach models artifacts of interventions that happen to defeat the evaluator.
SFT overfits synthetic style: Who&When performance peaks after two epochs and declines while Aegis-Bench performance continues to rise.
Macro-F1 trails Micro-F1 on rare modes, and the Appendix A.2 case shows all models, including Aegis, missing a subtle numeric root cause.
DyLAN post-hoc label refinement is insufficiently specified for independent audit.
Main text and Appendix D disagree on whether DCL used RTX 4090 or RTX 3090 GPUs.
Paper claims release of all models, but no official model artifact link was verified.
Mutable code/data histories, unpinned model APIs and missing cross-artifact manifest prevent immutable end-to-end replay.
归因目标等于计划注入；当多个智能体被扰动时，它并不确立每个注入错误都是必要的或独立因果的。
受控 MAST 模式注入可能无法代表涌现的、交互诱发的或先前未见的失败；论文明确将固定分类法与受控计划列为局限。
GAIA 失败筛选依赖于 GPT-4o-mini 语义判断，而格式归一化器、单位容差、代码测试和抽取规则也可产生假阳性或假阴性。
多个变体可源自同一任务或成功基线，但分组划分未披露，可能造成 train/test 结构性泄漏。
丢弃未失败的注入会移除韧性与自我纠正的证据，并可能让模型学到恰好击败评测器的干预产物。
SFT 过拟合合成风格：Who&When 性能在两个 epoch 后见顶并下降，而 Aegis-Bench 性能继续上升。
在稀有模式上 Macro-F1 落后于 Micro-F1，Appendix A.2 案例显示所有模型（包括 Aegis）都漏掉了一个细微的数值根因。
DyLAN 事后标签精炼的说明不足以支持独立审计。
正文与 Appendix D 在 DCL 使用的是 RTX 4090 还是 RTX 3090 GPU 上不一致。
论文声称发布全部模型，但未核验到官方模型产物链接。
可变的代码/数据历史、未钉扎的模型 API 以及缺失的跨产物清单阻止了不可变的端到端重放。

value.html: The paper reports three expert annotators for a 100-trajectory label-fidelity study, but recruitment, compensation, consent, raw labels, and adjudication are not disclosed. Other privacy/consent considerations are unknown.

value_zh.html: 论文报告三名专家标注者用于 100 条轨迹的标签保真度研究，但招募、报酬、同意、原始标签及裁定未披露。其他隐私/同意考量未知。

value.html: HF dataset metadata declares MIT; the GitHub code repository has an MIT license; arXiv v6 is CC BY 4.0. Rights and redistribution terms for upstream benchmark tasks, framework outputs, and model-generated traces are not reconciled.

value.html: Benchmark task -> successful GPT-4o-mini MAS trajectory -> injected faulty variant -> evaluator-confirmed failure -> planned agent/error labels -> JSONL split. Public IDs encode benchmark/model/framework and a suffix, but immutable baseline-to-variant linkage and discarded-attempt lineage are unknown.
